author: Yffe
content: Implement §7 step-4 mutation scoring across forge/src/mutation.rs (frozen deterministic mutator set: operator flips, off-by-ones, early returns, branch swaps; MUTANT_CAP=64; seeded from DEFAULT_SOLVER_SEED), check.rs (mutation_score reuses item_subprogram+thermite_lower::lower+run_verus through the proof cache; floor gate AFTER L3 success), manifest.rs (with_mutation_score / rejected_weak_contract; RejectReason cause WeakContract), cli.rs (--mutation-floor flag), main.rs (mod mutation), and forge/tests/mutation_conformance.rs (AC-1..4 vs conformance/mutation/cases.json). Polarity: a mutant verus PROVES = SURVIVED (contract too weak); verus FAILS = KILLED. mutants_killed stays oracle-excluded (verus-version-sensitive).
